content.comment_body: In [product_name] [version_no], how can you change the font color for block names or numbers at the top of blocks? For instance, if you set the background to dark grey, how do you make the fonts appear white for better contrast?
[product_name] [version_no]: Trying to change the block name/number font color, especially at the top of function blocks, so that numbers on a dark grey background display in white.
Select the text, right-click to access font options, and choose white for the font color. It might help to use hooks in the standard configuration.
I tried this solution before, but when I add a new block, its font color reverts to black and doesn't keep the change.
This is how it works for me: When I use the standard hook, the setting is retained for new blocks.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are having trouble maintaining custom font color settings in [product_name] [version_no] for function blocks, particularly when using a dark grey background. Although users can manually change the font color, the change isn't kept when creating new blocks, leading to inconsistent appearance and extra manual effort. This affects usability when users want their workspace to remain visually consistent.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want custom font color changes, such as setting the text to white for better contrast, to stay in place for all new blocks automatically, eliminating the need for repeated manual adjustments.
